title: SailSearch: Agent-Assisted Discovery in Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.25087v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present SailSearch, a human-guided workflow for algorithmic research with two language-model agents, and report results on Market Split and maximum independent set (MIS). For Market Split, our randomized algorithm searches across multiple lattice bases, dividing computation between enumeration and continued basis reduction. Across ten random seeds per instance, it found the first reported CPU-only solutions to 18 of 33 previously open QOBLIB instances, solving 130 to 133 of the 156 benchmark instances per seed with a 24-hour cutoff on two CPU cores. For MIS, our generator encodes planted XOR constraints as graphs with certified optima; on seven instances with 1,752 to 3,996 vertices, the best solutions returned by the tested solvers in eight-hour runs were 5 to 15 vertices below the optimum.

translated_title: SailSearch：智能体辅助的组合优化探索
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SailSearch，一种由人类引导、借助两个语言模型智能体进行算法研究的工作流，并报告了在Market Split问题和最大独立集（MIS）问题上的结果。对于Market Split问题，我们的随机算法在多个格基上进行搜索，将计算分配于枚举和持续基约简之间。在每个实例使用十个随机种子的实验中，该算法为33个此前未解决的QOBLIB实例中的18个找到了首次报道的纯CPU解决方案，在两个CPU核心、24小时时限内，每个种子可求解156个基准实例中的130至133个。对于MIS问题，我们的生成器将植入的XOR约束编码为具有认证最优解的图；在七个拥有1,752至3,996个顶点的实例上，所测试的求解器在8小时运行中返回的最佳解比最优解少5至15个顶点。
tldr: 该论文提出SailSearch——一个由两个语言模型智能体辅助、人类引导的算法研究工作流，其多格基随机算法首次为18个此前未解的QOBLIB Market Split实例找到纯CPU解决方案，并通过生成带认证最优解的MIS基准图揭示了现有求解器与最优解之间5至15个顶点的差距。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SailSearch, a human-guided algorithmic research workflow with two language-model agents, whose randomized multi-lattice-basis algorithm found the first reported CPU-only solutions to 18 previously open QOBLIB Market Split instances, and whose MIS generator with certified optima reveals that tested solvers fall 5 to 15 vertices short of the optimum.
